findings.highlight: The giant releases Tohsaka and charges straight for Saber.
findings.evidenceJa: 巨人は遠坂から手を離し、正面からセイバーへ斬りかかり
findings.governingReading: The giant releases Rin, then slashes at Saber head-on.
findings.explanation: Charges for Saber omits that Berserker attacks her with a cutting stroke.

findings.highlight: the holy sword that breaks the ground
findings.governingReading: The holy sword sweeps across the earth.
findings.explanation: Breaks the ground replaces the sword’s broad sweeping trajectory with damage to the ground.

findings.highlight: Saber must not be able to stand as she glares at Berserker on her knees
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーは地に伏したまま
findings.governingReading: Saber remains prone on the ground, unable even to stand, and stares at Berserker.
findings.explanation: On her knees raises Saber from a prone position and changes the physical tableau before her destruction.

findings.highlight: you would have been able to die
findings.evidenceJa: オマエも死にきれたでしょうに
findings.governingReading: Illya taunts that, had Saber possessed her full magical energy, Berserker might have been able to die completely.
findings.explanation: Die drops the completion force in 死にきれた, weakening the implication that the attack could exhaust Berserker’s remaining resurrection capacity.

findings.highlight: pieces of meat that used to be
findings.evidenceJa: 土塊と一体になった、セイバーの亡骸
findings.governingReading: Before Shirou lies Saber’s corpse, merged with the clods of earth.
findings.explanation: The English invents pieces of meat and prints several competing noun phrases instead of one coherent description.

findings.highlight: Take his legs away first so
findings.evidenceJa: まずはぁ、もう逃げ出せないようにしてあげちゃって
findings.governingReading: Illya tells Berserker first to make Shirou unable to escape again.
findings.explanation: The English begins an unsupported take-his-legs-away formulation and then prints two competing rewrites of the same command.

findings.highlight: Pain and despair shut off my senses.
findings.evidenceJa: 激痛と絶望で理性が焼き切れた
findings.governingReading: Agonizing pain and despair burn out Shirou’s reason.
findings.explanation: Senses changes the faculty destroyed by the trauma from rational control to sensory perception.

findings.governingReading: Shirou is carried farther and farther away from the clearing.
findings.explanation: Fading suggests loss of consciousness or existence instead of physical recession from the scene.

findings.highlight: Left in the clearing is Tohsaka’s body, already
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂だけが残っていた
findings.governingReading: Only Rin remains in the clearing, lying motionless for some time; the narration does not diagnose her death or say she was crushed.
findings.explanation: Body and crushed add an unsupported death implication and bodily condition while competing with the alternate printed wording motionless.
